office_does: The three county commissioners are Whitman County's executive and legislative authority: they adopt the budget and county ordinances, including zoning and planning, and appoint department heads.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Chad Whetzel, appointed in March 2025 and elected in November 2025, is the only candidate. District 3 voters nominated him in the primary; the whole county votes in the general.

candidates.summary: District 3 county commissioner since March 2025; Pullman-area farrier, longtime Fire District 12 EMT and captain, and former Planning Commission chair. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed in March 2025 to replace Michael Largent, then won the November 2025 election 4,594 to 4,116 [S5]
Planning Commission member for 12 years, eight as chair; Fire District 12 EMT and captain [S1]
Says he would balance "responsible growth" with preserving the county's rural heritage [S1]
